cues: Prepositions of time and place narrow down.
In is for the largest area: in May, in twenty twenty six, in winter, in the morning, in Nepal.
On is for a day or a surface: on Sunday, on the fifth of June, on my birthday, on the table.
At is for a single point: at six o'clock, at night, at the bus stop.
